proves.claim: with review.relaxRequiredFamily on and a relaxation witness for the seat, the familyAllows guard of reviewerChecks returns no refusal for a seat of another family on a --review-family item, and still returns O2_FAMILY_MATCH with the setting off.

store.io-board-review-family-relax-requi.why: Without this case reviewerChecks could keep withholding the witness from the family check, so next --verify would still refuse a witnessed seat that the required-family guard passed.
